music_policy: A new Tiny Tales melody, rhythm, instrumentation, connecting story and finale are used. Duck calls are performed as original effects, never spoken as quack words.

motion_language.edit_grid: 104 BPM, cuts on four-beat phrases, one longer hold for Mother Duck's search
motion_language.hierarchy: The visible duck count and one paddling/search action are primary; water and plants remain ambient.
motion_language.camera: One follow, push or pull per scene with clear leading room.
motion_language.restraint: No number cards, static lineups, random dancing or spoken animal-sound words.

lines.line: At sunrise, Mother Duck guided five little ducklings from their cozy nest into the sparkling river.
Five little ducks went paddling one day, under the bridge and round the bay.
Mother Duck called across the blue, but only four little ducks came through.

shots.effect: three real duck calls followed by bridge water

lines.line: Four little ducks curved round the tree. Mother Duck called, then there were three.

shots.effect: three real duck calls and three stepping-stone splashes

lines.line: Three little ducks found a waterfall view. Mother Duck called, then there were two.

shots.effect: three real duck calls with soft waterfall

lines.line: Two little ducks chased lantern light for fun. Mother Duck called, then there was one.

shots.effect: three real duck calls and one paddle wake

lines.line: When no ducklings returned, Mother Duck found five coloured leaves and followed their trail beside the river.
I see your trail. I am coming to find you.

shots.effect: gentle lantern bell and walking taps

lines.line: One, two, three, four, five came home, following the lantern glow.
Five little ducks, safe together. Home by the river, all together!

shots.effect: five arrival splashes and warm final duck calls
